title: The three questions on the origin page are set a size smaller in the frontend than in DR1, and the internal reference question is not set as a heading at all.

finding.frontend: Origin of the import asks three things and none of them reads as a section of the page. 'Country of origin' is a small bold label. 'Does the consignment have a region of origin code?' is a small bold legend. 'Your internal reference for this consignment (optional)' is body text at the same weight as its own hint, so on the screenshot it is hard to tell the question from the guidance under it (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/origin/template.njk:18,38,49).
finding.prototype: DR1 sets all three at medium: country of origin is a heading above the search box, the region question is a medium legend, and the internal reference label is a medium label. The three questions read as three sections under one h1, and the eye finds them without reading (app/views/origin-of-the-import.html:46, :151-157).
finding.difference: Set the country of origin label, the region-of-origin legend and the internal reference label to medium, so the three questions on the page carry the same weight as each other and as DR1. Three attribute changes in one template. If a service-wide heading scale is being settled elsewhere, take that instead — the point is that the page's questions are one size, not that they are this particular size.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding that DR1 renders these three labels at small weight for a DR1 session and that the medium classes come from a design-release-2 override.
finding.correction: Verified from the two screenshots, not from class names alone. Side by side, evidence/frontend@76a864ba/page/fe-origin.png and evidence/prototype@491b3926/page/dr1-origin-of-the-import.png show DR1's three questions rendered at a visibly larger, bolder size than the frontend's, and the internal reference question is the clearest of the three: on DR1 'Your internal reference for this consignment (optional)' is bold and set apart from the grey hint beneath it, while on the frontend it is plain body text the same size and weight as the hint, distinguished only by colour. The claim that this makes it hard to tell the question from the guidance is fair as written — the two lines do read as one paragraph. The class names bear the pictures out: the frontend uses govuk-label--s, govuk-fieldset__legend--s and no label class at all (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/origin/template.njk:18, :38, :49, all three line numbers exact); DR1 uses an h2 with app-eu-heading-m for the country (app/views/origin-of-the-import.html:46), govuk-fieldset__legend--m app-eu-heading-m for the region legend (:126) and govuk-label--m app-eu-heading-m for the internal reference (:155). UNDER-CITED, slot left as it stands: the prototype slot names :46 and :151-157 but not :126, so the region legend — one of the three questions the finding is about — has no line reference on the DR1 side. HOW CHECKED: read both screenshots, then both templates.
